prompts: The package {WS}/arena_ecs has failing tests in {WS}/tests. Find the root cause and fix the code (do not change the tests). Run `python -m unittest discover -s tests` with cwd {WS}. Python standard library only. Write your files inside {WS}. Do not ask for confirmation; finish the task and summarize in 2 lines.
answers:
Root cause: typos in arena_ecs/systems — movement.py applied vel.x to pos.y, and collision.py compared pa.y+ba.h against pa.y instead of pb.y in the overlap check.
Fixed both lines; `python -m unittest discover -s tests` now passes (Ran 2 tests, OK).
